description: As monotherapy for the treatment of adult patients with ALK-positive advanced NSCLC previously not treated with an ALK inhibitor.

contributions.description: Reinstated this indication (previously marked Withdrawn). It was added to NCCP regimen 00570 in version 4 (29/09/2022, "New indication added", reimbursement status CDS 01/10/2022) and remains in the Cancer Drugs Approved for Reimbursement list and on the NCCP Lung SACT regimens page, but the HSE website currently links to version 3 (03/11/2021), which predates it. Version 4 is archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20231001181432/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lung/570%20lorlatinib%20therapy.pdf
